h1: Custom Box Fit Workwear for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Box Fit Workwear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom box fit workwear in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Perfect for branding on roomy, comfortable apparel for your team.
introHtml: Box fit workwear offers a roomier cut through the chest and shoulders, giving employees unrestricted movement for demanding tasks. This relaxed silhouette layers easily over bulky gear or base layers, making it a practical choice for construction crews, warehouse teams, and outdoor workers. Customize Safety Tees, Carhartt vests, or hi-vis jackets with your logo using screen printing or embroidery. Durable fabrics like cotton duck or polyester blends hold up to repeated washing while keeping your brand visible.
heroAltText: Custom box fit workwear featuring a roomy Safety Tee and Carhartt Duck Vest with embroidered logo
